newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AIDA GIVES LEW GEFFEN MORE TIME FOR BID.
newsitem.headline: AIDA GIVES LEW GEFFEN MORE TIME FOR BID.

text.p: South African property group Aida Holdings Ltd announced on Thursday it was giving more time to a consortium which is bidding for a majority stake in the company.
Aida said in a statement it had given real estate businessman Lew Geffen until May 30 to fulfil the required conditions attached to his offer to buy 51 percent of the firm.
Last November, Aida issued a notice cautioning shareholders that Geffen had proposed to acquire the majority stake for a cash payment of 85 cents per share.
Aida on Thursday advised its shareholders to exercise caution pending a further announcement "which will be made as soon as the conditions...have been met".
Geffen said in a separate statement that he and his colleagues were "busy finalising certain funding and structural requirements necessary to fulfil the conditions".
